title: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls
slides: Why is The New York Times suing Brave?
It claims Brave bypassed paywalls to scrape articles
But Brave says its AI answers cite sources, not copy
Publishers must now audit how AI browsers read their sites
Check your own site: are AI crawlers paying to read?
thread_text:
1. The Times vs Brave

Brave's AI bypassed paywalls to scrape articles, according to a new lawsuit from The New York Times. The core question: is AI browsing just reading, or stealing?

2. Paywall Bypass Claims

The Times says Brave's browser used its AI to get around paywalls and scrape content. That's not indexing — that's extraction without permission.

3. Brave's Defense

Brave argues its AI answers only cite sources and never copy full text. If true, does that make it fair use, or still a paywall violation?

4. Your Site's Blind Spot

Publishers now need to audit how AI browsers access their content. Most have no idea which bots are reading, and whether they're paying.

5. Check Your Logs Today

Look at your server logs: are AI crawlers hitting your paywalled pages? If yes, you're already in this fight. What will you do about it?
